mentions.name: amika.dev
mentions.description: A platform that puts sandboxed agents on cloud VMs and lets you message them over the internet, creating agent + human devboxes. Coding agents can be chatted with from the web or automated via an API while directly controlling the VM, and it is being built to work on any computer, homelab, or Kubernetes cluster.
mentions.audience: Tech folks building or using agent + human devboxes
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm working on https://www.amika.dev/, which lets you put sandboxed agents on cloud VMs and then message them over the internet.

It's for agent + human devboxes, for chatting with coding agents from the web, or automating them with an API. Thing like Claude Code web, but any agent and you directly control the VM, too.

We're working to make amika.dev work on any computer, homelab, or K8S cluster. For tech folks, I describe it kinda like if Tailscale and Firecracker had a baby.

mentions.name: Amika
mentions.description: Amika is a cloud platform for spinning up sandboxed coding agents that can be controlled interactively or programmatically. Each sandbox comes preloaded with the user's git repos, a choice of coding agents, agent skills, MCP servers, and CLI tools, plus a live preview environment so the user and the AI can see changes in real time. Sandboxes can also be launched via API/CLI for automated background tasks such as catching Sentry issues and auto-fixing them, supporting hands-off "software factory" code generation workflows.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm a cofounder of Amika (https://www.amika.dev/) (OSS repo: https://github.com/gofixpoint/amika).

We let users spin up sandboxed coding agents in the cloud, and control them interactively or programmatically. Each sandbox comes loaded with your git repos, your pick of coding agents, agent skills, MCP servers, and CLI tools, plus a live preview environment so you and the AI can see changes in real time.
